query:
SELECT
            date,
            SUM(request_count) as total_requests,
            SUM(error_count) as total_errors,
            AVG(total_response_time_ms::float / NULLIF(request_count, 0)) as avg_response_time
        FROM api_usage
        WHERE government_id = $1
          AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - $2::integer
        GROUP BY date
        ORDER BY date DESC
